title: Grid
tagline: Future Solutions for Spatial Computing: Web3 3D Asset Marketplace, an AR AI Wearable and Geospatial AR
description:
Our project explores the intersection of Web3, AR, and geospatial technologies to unlock new dimensions in spatial computing. Here's what we're building:

    Web3 3D Asset Marketplace
    Leveraging Objaverse and Flow EVM, we are creating a decentralized marketplace where creators and developers can access, trade, and monetize 3D assets seamlessly. This platform democratizes 3D content, ensuring secure transactions and ownership on the blockchain.

    AR AI Wearable
    Using Unity and Meta Quest SDK, combined with Polygon POS blockchain, we are designing an augmented reality wearable device powered by AI. This innovative wearable integrates blockchain-backed interactions to deliver immersive experiences in fashion, gaming, and virtual environments.

    Geospatial AR Experience
    Inspired by NounsDao and utilizing Geospatial Creator, we are building a PokemonGo-equivalent experience. This geospatial AR application blends physical and digital realms, turning real-world locations into dynamic AR playgrounds enriched by community-driven content and blockchain incentives.
how_its_made:
Web3 3D Asset Marketplace: Made from open source database of open source, free, 3d models from sources like github, google, sketchfab, etc using Flow EVM to mint NFTs to trade 3d assets

AR AI Wearable: The future of AI/AR wearables, demonstrated using Meta Quest 3. Used Unity, Meta SDK, Android Studio, etc. Polygon Network

Geospatial AR: Using Nouns 3D to create the Nouns Go Experience.
